description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Energy Innovation: Policy and Technology LLC is seeking a Junior Node.js Developer to turn business needs and early-stage ideas into technical plans, prototypes, and reliable platform features. The role contributes across the software development lifecycle, building and supporting Node.js services while collaborating across the company’s technology stack.
Node.js Developer building services, integrating Angular and Ruby on Rails systems, and supporting authentication and database performance

Responsibilities:
• Partner with business stakeholders and technical teammates to understand requirements and translate them into technical specifications, development tasks, and realistic implementation plans
• Help turn early concepts into prototypes that can be tested, evaluated, and refined
• Build, test, document, and maintain Node.js services and application features, following established coding standards and contributing improvements where appropriate
• Collaborate with frontend and platform developers to connect services across the company’s technology stack, including systems built with Angular and Ruby on Rails
• Assist with secure authentication and authorization workflows, using suitable tools and established practices
• Contribute to database schema design and query optimization to support dependable performance as workloads grow
• Participate in code reviews, testing, deployment, documentation, and service support, including an on-call rotation as appropriate to your training and experience
• Share progress, raise risks early, and use feedback to continuously improve the quality and reliability of your work

Requirements:
• Applicants should have foundational knowledge of JavaScript and Node.js, along with an understanding of web application development and the software development lifecycle
• You should be able to communicate technical ideas clearly in writing and conversation, listen carefully to feedback, and work constructively with people across different disciplines
• We value sound analytical thinking, attention to detail, and the ability to break ambiguous requests into manageable tasks
• Candidates should be comfortable asking for guidance, incorporating review comments, and adapting plans as project needs evolve

Preferred:
• Familiarity with APIs, databases, authentication concepts, version control, and debugging practices is valuable
• Exposure to Angular, Ruby on Rails, Ansible, or similar tools is helpful, but a willingness to learn and apply new technologies is essential
• An internship or project experience in a collaborative, deadline-conscious environment is an advantage
